name: branding-modular-s-symbol-over-silhouette-portrait-with-palette-cards
title: Semi-transparent chrome symbol over a violet-lit profile, with cream, violet and charcoal spec cards
whatItIs: A board with a violet-toned side-profile portrait of a man with a large silver-gradient version of the modular symbol overlaid and the logo at the top left, and at right three stacked colour cards (white, violet, charcoal) with HEX, RGB and CMYK values.
whatItMeans: Thoughtful and premium; a chrome symbol over a face signals intelligence.
techniques: Overlay a gradient logo on a duotone portrait.
Stack colour spec cards on one side.

vocabulary.definition: A large logo placed over a photo.
A portrait rendered in two colours.
